----------

This website hosts the results of [VIBE](https://github.com/vector-index-bench/vibe/),
the Vector Index Benchmark for Embeddings.
You can use its interactive plots to explore the results of the benchmark.
In particular, head over to

- the [overview](/overview.html) page to compare all the algorithms across all datasets at a glance
- the [datasets](/datasets.html) page for detailed information about all the datasets we consider
- the [tradeoffs](/tradeoff.html) page to explore the tradeoff between recall and query throughput
- the [algorithm focus](/algorithm_focus.html) page to see the performance of
  _all_ the configurations we tested for each algorithm
- the [robustness](/robustness.html) page to investigate the robustness of algorithms
  with respect to the query difficulty

#### Run VIBE

The benchmark code and instructions for running the benchmark are available in
the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/vector-index-bench/vibe/).

#### Extend VIBE

Interested in contributing to the benchmark? Follow the guides for
[adding a new method](https://github.com/vector-index-bench/vibe/blob/main/docs/NEW_METHOD.md)
or
[a new dataset](https://github.com/vector-index-bench/vibe/blob/main/docs/NEW_DATASET.md).
